messages:
anna: FYI some customers on Vercel Edge reported `Unexpected token 'export'` when importing @redwood/inference-js. stack points to dist/index.cjs.
tom: that usually means the cjs artifact contains ESM syntax. which tag?
anna: 2.4.0 released yesterday. I ran `npm pack` and tarball has dist/index.mjs and dist/index.cjs but no .map files. package.json exports only point at ./dist/index.cjs.
ci-bot: publish log: tsup emitted .map files in workspace, but .npmignore contains `*.map` so npm pack excluded them.
tom: missing sourcemaps is one issue. the more pressing one is why index.cjs has `export` - possibly build config wrote ESM and a rename step changed extension without transpiling.
anna: confirmed: dist/index.cjs starts with `export const createClient =` — bad.
release-bot: created ticket INF-493: SDK publish produced ESM-in-CJS and dropped sourcemaps. assigned to tom.
tom: quick plan: (1) fix build to produce proper CJS (ensure tsup/rollup target for cjs path), (2) change package.json exports to dual form: import->index.mjs, require->index.cjs, types->index.d.ts, (3) stop excluding .map: remove `*.map` from .npmignore and add `dist/*.map` to package.json files, (4) ensure `npm run prepare` runs in CI before publish.
anna: also add CI smoke that runs `npm pack` and checks tarball includes `.map` and that index.cjs doesn't contain `^\s*export\s+`.
tom: agree. small doc note in README about importing in edge runtimes.
anna: I'll open a patch PR and run `npm pack` locally before tagging. will post pack contents here. :thumbsup:
release-bot: recommend publishing 2.4.1 and a `canary` tag after verification.
ci-bot: noted: previous publish used `--no-git-tag-version` which skipped prepare hooks; updated publish workflow to run prepare first.
tom: thanks. I'll follow up in INF-493 with the PR link and verification output.
